CS80 0.2.0 for macOS (Apple silicon and Intel, macOS 11 or later)

CS80.component is the Audio Unit, for Logic Pro and GarageBand.
CS80.vst3 is the VST3, for Ableton Live, Cubase, FL Studio, Reaper, Bitwig and Studio One.

1. Copy CS80.component to ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/
   and CS80.vst3 to ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/
   (in Finder: Go > Go to Folder, then paste the path).

2. The plug-ins are ad-hoc signed, not notarized by Apple, so macOS blocks
   them until you clear the quarantine flag. In Terminal:

   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/CS80.component
   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/CS80.vst3

3. Restart your DAW. It lists the plug-in as leblancfg > CS80.
   In GarageBand: new Software Instrument track, then Plug-ins >
   Instrument slot > AU Instruments > leblancfg > CS80.

If Logic or GarageBand doesn't see it, run this in Terminal and restart the DAW:

   killall -9 AudioComponentRegistrar; auval -v aumu Cs80 Lbfg

Source and notes: https://github.com/leblancfg/cs80
